entities.summary: Scott "Kidd" Poteet is an American retired pilot from the United States Air Force. He was the pilot of the Polaris Dawn mission in 2024, a privately funded human spaceflight operated by SpaceX for Jared Isaacman. Lives in Stratham, NH.
